title: Mary Grande oral history, Ellis Island Project
orientation: Recorded oral history interview conducted on August 28, 1989, in Denver, Colorado, by Andrew Phillips for the Ellis Island Oral History Project, catalogued as Interview Number 414 (DP-40). The interviewee is Mary Yankovik Grande, born in 1910, who recounts her childhood in a rural Yugoslav household, her 1920 voyage from Trieste to the United States as a child of about ten, and her subsequent life in America, including marriage, raising daughters, and decades of work in a Denver packing house. The transcript opens with archival header notes covering birth date, recording engineer, and transcript preparation, and includes one brief on-camera interruption by the interviewee's daughter, Mitzi Stackhouse. The recording runs approximately fifty minutes and was transcribed in 1989 and reconceived in 1996.
